title: About NovoTech Machine Tools — Mississauga, Canada
meta_description: NovoTech Machine Tools imports and supports metal fabrication machinery in Canada — Dener, ISITAN, Bekamak, Gecam, EUROSTAMP, CSM — from Mississauga.
intro: We help you get the right machines for your operation at a price that is right for your business. For more than 20 years, NovoTech Machine Tools has imported metal fabrication machinery from manufacturers we trust, and we sell, install and support every machine from our showroom and warehouse in Mississauga, ON.

story.title: Practical, cost-effective solutions
text: NovoTech is a results-driven company. We start with your parts: the material, the thickness, the length and how many you make in a shift. Then we recommend the machine and the options that fit the work, and we tell you when a smaller machine will do the job.

Many of our machines come in more than one line, so the budget fits as well as the work: brand-name machines from the manufacturers below, the NovoTech premium line built in Turkey to our specification with European components, and the NovoTech value line built to North American quality standards.

story.title: Machines in stock in Mississauga, ON
text: Our showroom and warehouse hold ironworkers, section benders, plate rollers, folding brakes, band saws, pipe polishers and long rows of rebar benders and cutters, ready to ship. Come and see a machine run, and bring a sample part or a drawing.
Machines in stock leave our warehouse within days, and we arrange the freight to your shop anywhere in Canada.

story.title: Manufacturers we trust
text: We have built strong partnerships with highly respected manufacturers in Turkey, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, Taiwan and China. Each of them builds what it knows best: Dener its press brakes, fiber lasers and shears, GMS its rebar benders and cutters, ISITAN its plate rollers and pipe benders, Bekamak its band saws.
We keep up with the technology and bring it to Canadian shops: servo-electric press brakes and panel benders, fiber lasers for sheet and tube, CNC tube benders and automatic rebar lines.

story.title: Service after the sale
text: Every machine we sell has a CSA-approved electrical panel for Canadian voltage and a one-year warranty. We stock spare parts in Mississauga, ON, install machines and train operators on request, and troubleshoot by video call when a machine needs help.

Our customers run one-person welding shops and production plants in steel structure, automotive, die and mold, medical and general part production, as well as rebar shops, HVAC contractors and window makers across Canada.

story.title: Our mission
text: To provide our customers with the right solution every time we are called upon: the machine that is right for the application at hand, and the parts, service and advice that keep it making money for years.

quote.intro: Tell us about your shop and the parts you make, and we will recommend the machine that fits — with pricing, delivery and the right voltage option.
